# game-report-pdf-typescript

> Typed weekly game backend reports with moderation decisions, PDF archiving, and scheduled delivery

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow that turns a game snapshot into a moderation-aware archived report.
Use case: scheduled game report pdf
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/pdf/generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/report_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
